summary: Assay worksheet for MV-2018-336, the QP07 absorption triage for Quorenthel Pharma GmbH, combining Caco-2, plasma binding and kinetic solubility. Matrix acceptance and accession-lot references precede interpretation; low-recovery and solubility-limited flux rows remain qualified. High efflux among interpretable soluble compounds, including QP07-08608 and QP07-08648, supports redesign of the exposed amine rather than increased lipophilicity.

sheets.name: Caco-2

rows.v: Caco-2 bidirectional permeability (house name: Caco-2 flux and efflux ratio)

rows: 10 µM dosing, pH 7.4, 120 min at 37 °C. Efflux ratio is Papp B-A over Papp A-B. Run acceptance requires monolayer integrity before/after exposure, paracellular-marker, reference-flux and vehicle controls against study-plan limits; the insert-linked acceptance and compound accession-lot records are retained under {{PRJ0060:lims_id}}. Accepted controls do not remove compound-specific recovery or solubility limitations.

Recovery below the study-plan window: QP07-08500, QP07-08524, QP07-08542, QP07-08600, QP07-08614, QP07-08638, QP07-08650 and QP07-08674. Retain observed flux values as qualified; exclude from the unqualified soluble-branch comparison.

Nominal dosing exceeds measured kinetic solubility for QP07-08522, QP07-08542, QP07-08584, QP07-08600, QP07-08618, QP07-08642 and QP07-08684. Apparent permeability/ratios are qualified and do not establish intrinsic efflux; no replacement measurements are inferred.

QP07-08608 and QP07-08648 have soluble dosing conditions, adequate reported recovery and elevated efflux ratios. These support the exposed-amine redesign after matrix acceptance, without relying on qualified rows.
